About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Please state your consent ID and date when you contact us regarding your consent.

Prepare to take a leading place in today's global economy with a career-launching qualification in accounting and finance.

          
Our courses are designed in partnership with leading professional bodies and delivered by lecturers with strong experience and connections in the industry.
Gain accreditation from leading professional bodies, including the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA), and the Association of Corporate Treasurers (ACT).
Your studies count towards professional qualifications, helping you fast-track your career with exemptions from certain exams.
Between your second and third years, you can also take part in paid work placements, giving you valuable hands-on experience and a further head start in your career.

        

      

    

  



    
    




    

        

          

          
   
          

          

          

            
 
              
Why choose Herts


            
              

                
Accounting and finance degrees at the University of Hertfordshire equip you with the skills, professional knowledge, and practical experience to succeed in a competitive finance career. You'll be immersed in the latest trends and practices accounting, business, economics, and finance.
Graduates have gone on to work with leading employers such as Citibank, Amazon, PwC and Disney, as well as organisations like the NHS, John Lewis and TUI. From investment banking to asset management roles, Herts alumni are shaping the future of finance worldwide.

              

              

            

            

          



      

      

            
              

                

                  

                    
                  

                  

                    
Guardian Top 40 University

                    
We’ve ranked 37th for teaching quality, student satisfaction and graduate success in the Guardian University Guide 2027.

                  

                

              

            
              

                

                  

                    
                  

                  

                    
Work placement opportunities

                    
Gain invaluable industry experience and build your network through paid work placements.

                  

                

              

            
              

                

                  

                    
                  

                  

                    
Leading industry accreditations

                    
Benefit from professional links with leading bodies including ACCA, CIMA and ACT.

                  

                

              

            
              

                

                  

                    
                  

                  

                    
Get a head start on your career

                    
Our courses provide exemptions from certain professional examinations.
